definitions.explanation: Continuing without any pause or interruption. Describes actions, sounds, or states that persist without stopping. Can be positive (constant effort) or negative (unrelenting noise).

examples.japanese: {絶|た}え{間|ま}ない⟦{努力|どりょく}→努力：03490_doryoku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{実|みの}った→実る：00282_minoru⟧。
⟦{工事|こうじ}→工事：00244_kouji⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{絶|た}え{間|ま}ない⟦{騒音|そうおん}→騒音：03315_souon⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{悩|なや}まされている→悩ます：12602_nayamasu⟧。
examples.english: I'm troubled by the constant noise from construction.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{店|みせ}→店：00497_mise⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{絶|た}え{間|ま}ない⟦{人気|にんき}→人気：01488_ninki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{誇|ほこ}り→誇る：14180_hokoru⟧、⟦いつ→いつ：00536_itsu⟧⟦{行|い}って→行く：00119_iku⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{行列|ぎょうれつ}→行列：09699_gyouretsu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦できている→できる：00557_dekiru⟧。
examples.english: This shop boasts unending popularity, and there is always a line no matter when you go.

notes:
USAGE:
{絶|た}え{間|ま}ない is a compound adjective formed from ⟦{絶|た}え{間|ま}→絶え間：21499_taema⟧ (a gap or pause in continuation) + ⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧ (without). It always modifies a noun. The adverbial form {絶|た}え{間|ま}なく is used to modify verbs.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {絶|た}え{間|ま}ない⟦{努力|どりょく}→努力：03490_doryoku⟧ (ceaseless effort)
- {絶|た}え{間|ま}ない⟦{騒音|そうおん}→騒音：03315_souon⟧ (constant noise)
- {絶|た}え{間|ま}なく⟦{続|つづ}く→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧ (to continue without pause)
- {絶|た}え{間|ま}なく⟦{流|なが}れる→流れる：01969_nagareru⟧ (to flow ceaselessly)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {絶|た}え{間|ま}ない: ceaseless (emphasizes no pauses or gaps)
- ⟦{止|や}む→止む：01153_yamu⟧こと⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧: unceasing (literary, similar meaning)
- ⟦{延々|えんえん}→延々：05896_enen⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧: endlessly (adverb, emphasizes tedious length)
- ⟦{常|つね}→常：28958_tsune⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧: always, constantly (neutral, factual)
